text_block_list.text:
—The end of the year. While everyone talks 
of 'forgetting the old year'...

There was an unforgettable event. That 
was—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
—The Tenno Sho (Spring). Neo Universe 
suffers a crushing defeat in 10th place. 
And then—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ""NIZR". —"Disappearing"."

A memory so intense, it never leaves my 
mind for even a moment.

In another universe, Neo Universe 
disappears after the Tenno Sho (Spring)...

Still, an Umamusume suddenly disappearing 
is impossible. There's no way it could 
happen.
The only possibilities are...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Cafe Waitress
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much~. We look forward to 
seeing you again♪
――"Retirement." Now that is plausible.

It's quite common for an Umamusume in a 
slump to retire and return to an ordinary 
life. Other times—
(Click-clack, click-clack...)

――"Disappearance." I hate to think about 
it, but it's entirely possible.

Disgusted with their inability to win, 
they just want to run away from racing. 
There are certainly Umamusume like that.

However... it just doesn't sit right with 
me. Considering the darkness in Neo 
Universe's voice when she said she'd 
"disappear," it lacks weight.

Rummaging through literature one after 
another in the library. Even a mere 
hypothesis would do, just any clue...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um... Trainer-san. Are you looking for 
something?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sorry if I'm interrupting. But, um... 
I just thought I might be able to help."

Whenever I'm researching something, Zenno 
Rob Roy always comes to my rescue.

...I decided to ask for advice while 
keeping the details under wraps.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"The disappearance of an existence in 
another universe... is it? How impressive, 
to have an interest in such things..."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Still, sci-fi novels like that have been 
around for a long time, and they've been 
appearing in movies lately too, haven't 
they?
choice_data_list: Could you share your thoughts with me?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I... suppose so. Even if it's a parallel 
universe, if it's a similar world, the 
laws should be the same...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I believe that whatever doesn't happen in 
this world won't happen in another 
universe either. Someone simply vanishing 
seems quite impossible.

As expected, it cannot happen. If Zenno 
Rob Roy, who knows so many books inside 
and out, says so, it must be true.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Still...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Even if truly disappearing is impossible, 
it might still 'feel like it 
disappeared.'"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
In other words, this is what it means. 
Hypothetically, if we could observe events 
in a different universe...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Those observing from the meta-universe 
would be watching through "something," 
wouldn't they?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
For example, "peep holes" or "wormholes." 
Do you study things like that in your 
Trainer coursework?

It was almost entirely sports science and 
sports medicine; I was never taught 
anything resembling space science.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Looking at things through "something"... 
means you will always be influenced by 
that "something."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Could it be that, under its influence, it 
merely appears to have vanished? For 
instance...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
If you look through frosted glass, the 
whole world looks cloudy, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Even if that other universe isn't cloudy, 
from an observer's point of view, it can 
only appear that way."

I felt like I understood a little. If it 
happens to get caught in that filter, some 
things remain unseen even though they 
clearly exist.

As expected of Zenno Rob Roy. She proved 
to be quite knowledgeable.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, um... Could it be, by any 
chance...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Do you mean... Uni-san?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
No, it's not like I have a specific idea 
in mind. It's just...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I think the reason Trainer is being so 
serious is because it's about Uni-san.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Please do your best. I... with Uni-san 
and Trainer..."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"I want to keep running just as I always 
have. If only you could help my beloved 
Uni-san..."

We made our promise with a smile, and I 
left the library.

And so, this year's story came to an end, 
opening the door to a brand-new tale. 
However—

I was certain. The next year would be the 
most critical chapter in Neo Universe's 
story.
